idea-plugin.name: Data Engineering Agent Skills
idea-plugin.description:
Install data engineering skill packs, agent adapters, starter packs, MCP templates, and runnable examples into JetBrains IDE workspaces.

  • Install the full toolkit or a smaller starter surface
  • Add agent adapters for Claude, Copilot, Gemini, Kiro, Codex, OpenCode, and Windsurf-style workflows
  • Scaffold runnable examples and MCP templates directly into the current project
idea-plugin.change-notes: Initial marketplace-ready JetBrains plugin scaffold with installer actions for the core toolkit, starter packs, MCP templates, runnable examples, and GitHub release distribution.
